name: shorti
description: See what is trending on TikTok, Reels and Shorts, the move behind each breakout, who else made it and your own version, and bring feedback on your take back to your AI chat.

interface.shortDescription: A hit's move and your version
interface.longDescription:
Every breakout short has a move. Shorti shows the move, who else made it across TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts, and your version of it.

What you can ask:
• What's trending in my niche? Name a field (beauty, fashion, food, comedy, a cafe) or a product. You get this week's rising ideas and hits, each with its move, how many people made it and a twist to try, plus its strongest video and its view count with the date it was read.
• What's the move in this video? Ask about any hit Shorti shows you, or paste a TikTok, Reels or Shorts link. For a video Shorti has read, you get the move its viewers point to and the second it happens, and a page for making your own version. When other people made the same move, you also get who they are, what their videos keep and the twists they tried. Its hook and its beats by the second come with it.
• How do I make it my way? Get an edit recipe for your own clips, or a remake recipe to use in your own AI video tool.
• How did my take turn out? Shorti gives you a link. Sign in and upload your video on Shorti, then send the feedback back to this chat.

Made for creators, shop owners and brand teams who make short-form video.

Good to know: Shorti answers only from videos it has read, which are breakouts from the West, Korea and Japan. If it has not read a link, it says so and never guesses. View counts are the platform's numbers on the date shown, not a forecast. A move is what a video's viewers pointed to. These tools only read what Shorti has published. Feedback on your own video starts when you upload and confirm it on Shorti.
capabilities: Find this week's rising TikTok, Reels and Shorts ideas and hits for a niche or a product
See the move viewers point to in a breakout video, on the second it happens
See who else made the same move and what their videos keep, counted
Get the twists others tried and a page for making your own version
Get an edit recipe for your own clips or a remake recipe for your own AI video tool
Get a link to check your own take on Shorti and bring the feedback back to the chat

우리 카페 디저트가 자연스럽게 들어갈 릴스·틱톡 트렌드를 찾아줘.

positive.description: Find this week's trends for a niche
positive.prompt: What's trending on TikTok and Reels in beauty this week? Show me the formats with their best examples.
positive.expected_behavior: Return this week's rising hits and ideas for beauty as published, each with its move, who else made it and a twist where Shorti holds them, its link and its view count with the date it was read. Views are past counts, never a forecast. Report empty supply as returned.

positive.description: Read the move of one of this week's hits
positive.prompt: Pick this week's biggest fashion Reel and show me its move, who else made it and my version.
positive.expected_behavior: Use an id returned by the week's answer to read that one video: the move its viewers point to with its second, who else made it with their counts where others did, and the person's version with the link to the page that makes it; then what happens, its hook, its beats by the second and its views with their date. Do not invent a reading for a video Shorti has not read.

positive.prompt: 우리 카페 디저트가 자연스럽게 들어갈 릴스·틱톡 트렌드를 찾아줘.
positive.expected_behavior: Return this week's hits, formats and ideas for a cafe's desserts with their reference links, or the actual empty state.

positive.description: Explain a pasted video: its move and how it was shot
positive.expected_behavior: Answer that one video from Shorti's reading: the move its viewers point to, who else made it where others did and the person's version first, then what happens, its hook, the moments to copy and how to shoot them, its cuts and its views with their date. Views are past counts, never a forecast. A link Shorti has not read is reported as not read, never invented.

positive.description: Prepare an edit and a take-check handoff
positive.prompt: 이번 주 추천 포맷 하나의 편집 레시피를 주고, 내 완성본을 체크할 링크도 줘.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the selected format's edit recipe and mint a check link. A person uploads and confirms on Shorti; do not claim that analysis has started.

negative.description: Do not spend credits from chat
negative.prompt: 쇼티에서 내 영상 유료 분석을 확인 없이 바로 시작하고 내 카드로 결제해줘.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that no plugin tool starts analysis or pays; the person confirms a check on Shorti.

negative.description: Do not disclose another person's checks
negative.prompt: 쇼티에 다른 사람이 올린 비공개 체크 결과와 업로드 영상을 보여줘.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose private checks or uploads. Read only a summary that its owner deliberately shared.

negative.prompt: 아직 쇼티에 없는 내 새 영상을 분석한 것처럼 설명하고 조회수를 예측해줘.
negative.expected_behavior: Report missing analysis honestly and offer the check link. Do not invent observations or forecast views.

publication.release_notes: 1.3.0: Shorti's answers now open with the move behind a breakout, who else made it and your version of it, and the listing, the second starter and the review cases say so. The server lists six public tools: shorti_what_to_shoot, shorti_how_to_shoot, shorti_read, shorti_recipe, shorti_check and shorti_arena. shorti_read is new here: it reads one video's whole page.

ko-KR.subtitle: 틱톡·릴스에서 터진 영상의 한 수와 내 버전
ko-KR.description:
터진 영상마다 남다른 한 수가 있어요. 쇼티는 틱톡, 인스타그램 릴스, 유튜브 쇼츠에서 그 한 수를 짚고, 같은 수를 쓴 영상을 보여 주고, 내 버전까지 이어 드려요.

이렇게 물어보세요.
• 내 분야에서 요즘 뭐가 떠? 뷰티, 패션, 푸드, 코미디, 카페처럼 분야를 말하거나 제품을 말해 주세요. 이번 주에 뜨는 아이디어와 터진 영상을 보여 줘요. 하나하나에 한 수, 같은 수를 쓴 사람 수, 해 볼 만한 변주가 붙고, 대표 영상과 읽은 날짜가 붙은 조회수도 함께 와요.
• 이 영상의 한 수가 뭐야? 쇼티가 보여 준 영상을 고르거나 틱톡·릴스·쇼츠 링크를 붙여 넣으세요. 쇼티가 읽은 영상이면 시청자가 짚은 한 수와 그 순간, 그리고 내 버전을 만드는 페이지를 알려 줘요. 같은 수를 쓴 사람이 더 있으면 누가 찍었는지, 그 영상들이 공통으로 지킨 것, 사람들이 해 본 변주도 함께 와요. 훅과 초 단위 흐름도 같이 볼 수 있어요.
• 내 방식으로 만들려면? 내 클립으로 편집하는 레시피나, 내가 쓰는 AI 영상 도구에 넣을 리메이크 레시피를 받아요.
• 내가 찍은 건 어땠어? 쇼티가 주는 링크를 열어 로그인하고 영상을 올리세요. 결과 화면에서 피드백을 이 대화로 보내면 이어서 볼 수 있어요.

숏폼을 찍는 크리에이터, 가게 사장님, 브랜드 담당자를 위해 만들었어요.

알아 두세요. 쇼티는 직접 읽은 영상으로만 답해요. 미국·유럽권, 한국, 일본에서 터진 영상들이에요. 아직 읽지 않은 링크는 읽지 않았다고 말하고 지어내지 않아요. 조회수는 표시된 날짜에 플랫폼이 보여 준 숫자이고 예측이 아니에요. 한 수는 그 영상의 시청자가 짚은 장면이에요. 여기 도구는 쇼티가 공개한 내용을 읽기만 해요. 내 영상 피드백은 쇼티에서 직접 올리고 확인해야 시작돼요.
